arithmetic: for every linear-source-induced R at each stated prime, enumerate all d|K^2 with 4d=-1 (mod R); when there is no hit, decide whether -1 belongs to the exact generated subgroup of the prime residues of K
scope_note: This is a complete finite classification of all target-spectrum states on seven frozen primes. It does not compare the varying unit groups across R and does not prove a universal selector.
